name: max_eig_tridiag_3x3
description: 3x3 SDP: max <A,X> s.t. tr(X)=1, X 3x3 PSD, where A=[[3,1,0],[1,2,1],[0,1,1]]. By variational formula opt=lambda_max(A). Eigenvalues are roots of (3-t)(2-t)(1-t)-2(3-t)-1, giving an irrational lambda_max. Optimal X* is the rank-1 projector onto the max eigenvector (singular, boundary optimum).
reference_method: Exact closed form: lambda_max of [[3,1,0],[1,2,1],[0,1,1]] computed symbolically in Mathematica. Characteristic polynomial roots obtained via Root[] and evaluated to 65 digits.
